ns2:course.label: Microbial Biochemistry
ns2:course.description: Examines the biochemical ecology of diverse microbial groups with emphasis on anaerobic systems. Prerequisite: MCB 250 and MCB 354 or MCB 450, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MCB 250 and MCB 354 or MCB 450, or consent of instructor.
